_schema.desc: A8 中性音樂創意庫（不綁供應商）＝prompt→產出 可回溯目錄。歌詞為我們資產；引擎 prompt 為可攜變體；outputs 記實際成品。押韻經 a8_lyrics_engine.analyze_rhyme(十三轍) 評分。

fields.lyrics_reviewed: 已審+押韻升級的定稿歌詞(乾淨版)

entries.concept: 托嬰畢業典禮甜點桌，歡樂中帶溫馨，把場景寫成歡快中文饒舌

entries.rhyme_note: v1→v2 押韻升級(a8_lyrics_engine/十三轍)：雙押 2→4 行；Chorus 一七單押+『神氣/心裡』雙押+內韻『整齊』；Verse 懷來單押+『好乖/到嗨』雙押；rhymed_ratio 1.0。品牌安全維持(無禁用詞、台南外燴+MAPLAB 在)。
entries.expected_style: 約 2–3 分鐘完整歌(可截 30s)：歡快中文 hip-hop / boom bap；男聲 rap 主歌＋女聲洗腦副歌；jazzy 鋼琴＋boom-bap 鼓＋輕黑膠；~85–95 BPM；hook『邦尼兔畢業啦』記憶點強。tag 為機率提示，可能 regenerate 2–3 次。

brand_safety.notes: a8_lyrics_engine 過：無禁用詞/敏感；客戶名+台南外燴+MAPLAB 已置入；結構標籤齊；押韻已升級

engine_prompts.suno: Chinese hip-hop, boom bap, playful and warm, male rap verses with a catchy female sung hook, jazzy piano, boom-bap drums, light vinyl crackle, around 90 BPM, clear natural Mandarin vocals, radio-clean mix

suno_variants.trap: Chinese trap, warm and playful, male rap, punchy 808 bass and crisp hi-hats, around 140 BPM, clear Mandarin vocals
suno_variants.lofi: Chinese lo-fi hip hop, cozy nostalgic, soft warm vocal, mellow Rhodes keys and brushed drums, around 75 BPM, clear Mandarin vocals

engine_prompts.minimax: Chinese hip-hop boom bap, playful and warm, male rap with sung hook, jazzy piano, around 90 BPM (prompt=style; lyrics 另填)
engine_prompts.fal: same as minimax (text-to-music: prompt=style, lyrics=歌詞)
